about: The brand of the cabinet: its name and colours. logo.svg next to this file is the logo, drawn in white.
name: the heading of the Recommended group on the console screen, in capitals.
accent: highlights, selection frames and key caps. text and muted: the two text colours. ink: the darkest ground and the text on accent.
ground: the background gradient from left to right. load_track: the unlit part of the loading bar. start_strips: the six strips of the start animation, which it shades darker and lighter.
warning: facts on the settings screen that need attention. Colours are red, green and blue from 0 to 255.
